msg: unsafeHTML() hands the string to the HTML parser - lit-html does not escape it.
fix: Drop unsafeHTML and bind the value as text, or run it through DOMPurify.sanitize() first.

msg: unsafeSVG() parses the string as SVG markup, which can carry script and event attributes.
fix: Render the shape from data with svg`...` instead of injecting markup.

msg: unsafeStatic() splices the value into the template text before it is parsed and cached.
fix: Use literal`...` values you wrote yourself, never a runtime string.

msg: A javascript: URL in a template attribute runs on click.
fix: Use a normal https: URL and move the behaviour to an @click handler.

msg: A URL attribute bound straight from data - lit escapes the characters but keeps the scheme.
fix: Pass it through a helper that accepts only http: and https: before binding.

msg: A .innerHTML property binding writes raw markup into the element.
fix: Bind the value as template text, or set .textContent instead.

msg: Assigning .innerHTML in component code bypasses the template and its escaping.
fix: Render through this.render() / html`...` or assign .textContent.

msg: srcdoc is a document body - a binding here becomes markup inside the iframe.
fix: Point the iframe at a src URL you control, or sandbox it and post the data in.

msg: An on* attribute binding is compiled as an inline handler string, not a listener.
fix: Use the lit event binding @click=${this.onClick} with a function reference.

msg: A binding inside <style> lands in CSS text, where lit-html applies no escaping.
fix: Move the value to a bound style property or a CSS custom property on the host.

msg: A binding inside <script> becomes JavaScript source at parse time.
fix: Delete the inline script and read the value from a property in the component class.

msg: document.write() parses its argument as markup in the page document.
fix: Render the content through the component template instead.

msg: insertAdjacentHTML() inserts parsed markup next to the element.
fix: Create the node and set .textContent, or render it from the template.

msg: This file injects markup but never calls a sanitizer, so nothing narrows what the parser accepts.
fix: Add DOMPurify.sanitize() at the injection point or remove the unsafe directive.

msg: EU CRA Article 14 reporting is live: an actively exploited vulnerability in a shipped product needs an early warning within 24 hours, a notification within 72 hours and a final report within 14 days.
fix: Close the bindings above before the component ships, so the clock never starts.
